headline: SCCO Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong Metal Prices Despite Low Volumes
summary: Southern Copper beats EPS estimates as record revenues, profit and cash flow were fueled by higher metal prices, even as copper production and sales volumes declined.

headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Freeport-McMoRan, Raises Price Target to $82
summary: Barclays  analyst Richard Garchitorena   maintains Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $80 to $82.
